<!--
  The order summary card of the cart page and the checkout: the lines in short (optional), a promo code field
  with ready codes, the free-delivery progress, the totals, the button and a note. Static markup.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Promo, CartSummaryLabels } from "./cart-summary-card.types";
  import type { CartLine } from "../blocks/cart-list.types";
  import type { SummaryRow } from "../blocks/order-summary.types";

  export type CartSummaryCardProps = {
    lines: CartLine[];
    rows: SummaryRow[];
    promos: Promo[];
    labels: CartSummaryLabels;
    items?: "show" | "hide";
    promo?: "show" | "hide";
    field?: string;
    progress?: "show" | "hide";
    value?: number;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Badge from "../primitives/badge/badge.svelte";
  import Button from "../primitives/button/button.svelte";
  import Group from "../primitives/group/group.svelte";
  import Inline from "../primitives/inline/inline.svelte";
  import Input from "../primitives/input/input.svelte";
  import List from "../primitives/list/list.svelte";
  import ListItem from "../primitives/list/list-item.svelte";
  import Progress from "../primitives/form/progress.svelte";
  import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../primitives/text/text.svelte";
  import Title from "../primitives/title/title.svelte";
  import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.svelte";
  import { cn, fmtMoney, tpl } from "../utils";

  let {
    lines,
    rows,
    promos,
    labels,
    items = "hide",
    promo = "show",
    field = "promo",
    progress = "show",
    value = 70,
  }: CartSummaryCardProps = $props();
</script>

<Stack gap="6" align="stretch" class="rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border p-6" data-testid="summary">
  <Group gap="4" align="baseline" justify="between">
    <Title as={2} size="lg" weight="semibold">
      {labels.title}
    </Title>
    <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
      {tpl(labels.items, ((lines?.length ?? 0) == null ? undefined : String((lines?.length ?? 0))))}
    </Text>
  </Group>
  {#if ((items as string) === "show")}
    <List tag="ul" class="flex flex-col gap-4" data-testid="summary-lines">
      {#each lines as line (line.id)}
        <ListItem class="flex items-center gap-4 text-sm">
          <MediaFrame alt={line.name} ratio="1/1" class="size-12 shrink-0" />
          <Stack gap="0" class="flex-1">
            <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
              {line.name}
            </Text>
            <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
              {tpl("{0} x {1}", line.qty, fmtMoney(line.price, line.currency))}
            </Text>
          </Stack>
          <Inline class="font-medium">
            {fmtMoney((line.price * line.qty), line.currency)}
          </Inline>
        </ListItem>
      {/each}
    </List>
  {/if}
  {#if ((promo as string) === "show")}
    <Stack gap="2" align="stretch" data-testid="promo">
      <Group gap="2" align="center">
        <Input type="text" name={field} aria-label={labels.promo} placeholder={labels.promo} class="min-w-0 flex-1" />
        <Button variant="outline" size="default" type="button">
          {labels.apply}
        </Button>
      </Group>
      <Group gap="2" align="center" class="flex-wrap">
        <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
          {labels.codes}
        </Text>
        {#each promos as c (c.id)}
          <Badge variant="outline" size="sm" data-testid="code">
            {c.code}
          </Badge>
        {/each}
      </Group>
    </Stack>
  {/if}
  {#if ((progress as string) === "show")}
    <Stack gap="2" align="stretch" class="rounded bg-muted p-4" data-testid="progress">
      <Text size="sm">
        {labels.progress}
      </Text>
      <Progress value={(value == null ? undefined : String(value))} max="100" aria-label={labels.progress} />
    </Stack>
  {/if}
  <List tag="ul" class="flex flex-col gap-2">
    {#each rows as row (row.id)}
      <ListItem
        class={cn(
          "flex items-center justify-between gap-4",
          (
            row.strong ? "border-t border-border pt-4 text-base font-bold"
            : "text-sm text-muted-foreground"
          )
        )}
        data-testid="row"
      >
        <Inline>
          {row.label}
        </Inline>
        <Inline>
          {fmtMoney(row.amount, row.currency)}
        </Inline>
      </ListItem>
    {/each}
  </List>
  <Button variant="default" size="lg" class="w-full" data-testid="checkout">
    {labels.checkout}
  </Button>
  <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
    {labels.note}
  </Text>
</Stack>
